in_sanskrit.name: स्रिमन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: स्रिः (shrih) - Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity + मन्त् (mant) - Intelligent, Wise

in_hindi.name: स्रिमन्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री (shri) - Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity + मन्त् (mant) - Intelligent, Wise

in_tamil.name: ஸ்ரீமந்த
in_tamil.meaning: பெரியவர் (periyavar) - Elder, Senior + திரு (thiru) - Holy, Sacred + மந்திரன் (mantiran) - Intellect, Wisdom

in_marathi.name: Srimanta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Srimanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses great wisdom and knowledge, a scholar

in_bengali.name: Srimanta
